name: Gold Coast Dive Adventures
summary: A PADI Dive Centre running small-group offshore boat dives for certified divers from Runaway Bay Marina on the Gold Coast. Trips visit local reefs and wrecks, Wonder Reef, Cook Island Marine Reserve, Nine Mile Reef and North Stradbroke Island, with an in-water dive guide. The team also teaches PADI courses from Open Water to Divemaster and runs occasional day and weekend trips further afield.
standouts: Small groups of up to 5 divers per in-water dive guide
Two dive vessels in full commercial survey

contact.address: 247 Bayview St, Runaway Bay, Qld 4216, Gold Coast

trips.title: Gold Coast Reef + Wreck Dive Trip
trips.summary: A double dive from Runaway Bay Marina to the local reefs and wrecks, such as Palm Beach Reef and the historic wreck of the Scottish Prince. The sites are chosen on the day from the conditions and the experience of the divers on board. Groups are small, with five divers maximum per group and an in-water dive guide.
highlights: Small groups, 5 divers maximum per group
In-water dive guides provided
Sites within 15 to 25 minutes by boat; no wreck certification needed
Snacks, hot soup and tea provided between dives

trips.title: North Stradbroke Island Triple Dive Trip
trips.summary: A three-dive day from Runaway Bay Marina to the dive sites around Point Lookout on North Stradbroke Island. Flat Rock is known for grey nurse sharks in the cooler months and Manta Bommie for its manta ray cleaning station in the warmer months. The trip out takes between 1 hour and 1 hour 45 minutes, depending on the route.
highlights: Grey nurse sharks June to October, manta rays October to April
In-water dive guide
Small groups of no more than 5 divers in each group
Lunch, snacks and refreshments provided

trips.title: Advanced Nine Mile Reef Triple Dive Trip
trips.summary: An advanced drift dive trip to Nine Mile Reef, off Tweed Heads, a grey nurse shark site in the winter months. After the first dive the boat shelters at Cook Island for the surface interval, and a later dive may be a wreck such as the Scottish Prince on the way home. Currents can be strong, so divers need to stay calm and control their buoyancy.

trips.title: Wonder Reef & Wreck of The Scottish Prince Double Dive Trip
trips.summary: A double dive on Wonder Reef, an artist-designed buoyant reef made of nine reef spirals, about 2.5 kilometres offshore from Philip Park on The Spit. The reef varies in depth from 8 to 30 metres, which suits a range of diver levels, and it was designed by Australian artist Daniel Templeton. The trip is also listed with the wreck of the Scottish Prince.
highlights: Nine buoyant reef spirals anchored to the seafloor
Depth varies from 8 to 30 metres
Suits a range of diver levels
About a 10 minute boat ride from the Gold Coast Seaway

trips.checkNotes: The page says this experience is run by a partner PADI Dive Centre, Queensland Scuba Diving Company, departing daily from Mariners Cove in Main Beach, not by Gold Coast Dive Adventures; check that it should appear on this operator's page. priceFrom is the page's 'From $119.00' for the introductory dive; the snorkelling and observer price is lower ($69). Tours run once a day and departure times vary with the tide. The only photo on the page is a page header image of unconfirmed ownership, so none are recorded. The FAQ gives the departure address (berth 91, Mariners Cove Marina, 60 Seaworld Drive, Main Beach).

offers.text: GCDA Diving Family club: members-only dive trips and events, priority seats on trips away and discounted standby dives
offers.conditions: Conditions apply. Members join by diving with the operator or asking in the shop.

checkNotes: All bookings on the site go through one Rezdy account, thescubacoach.rezdy.com, so rezdyAlias is 'thescubacoach'. No Rezdy page was opened. The site names 'The Scuba Coach' as the group that found Migaloo Reef, so this may be the operator's earlier or sister name. Most trips have their own booking link; North Stradbroke Island and Nine Mile Reef have a Rezdy catalog link plus an embedded calendar, and the five trips away (Flinders Reef, HMAS Brisbane, Julian Rocks, North Solitary Islands, South West Rocks) and Tufi are sold only through a calendar embedded on their page, so the page URL is recorded. Live dates, departure times and some prices exist only in those Rezdy calendars. Times on the site are meeting times, not departure times. The FAQ page has older, much lower prices than the trip and course pages ($135 double dive, $795 standard course) and a different phone number (0488365502); used the trip and course pages and the 0404 286 599 number shown across the site. The FAQ gives the marina address as Hollywell and the Courses page also says Hollywell, while the footer says Runaway Bay. Group and fleet figures differ across pages: 5 divers per guide, a maximum of 12 on the boat, 8 divers elsewhere; two vessels on the boats page and three in the highlights (Blue Manta II, Ocean Wanderer and Aurora on the About page). Not included as trips: conservation events (only a Rezdy catalog link on the Sea Shepherd page), a winter 'Shark Diving and Education' program mentioned without details, whale watching and freediving (named only in a meeting-point heading and 2018 videos), the dive shop, gear hire and equipment servicing, and past overseas trips. Some trips away appear to be run with partners (Queensland Scuba Diving Company for the Wave Break Island introductory dive, Wooli Dive and South West Rocks Dive Centre for weekends); confirm before publishing. The hero photo was chosen from the site's own page header images by size and placement without being viewed, so a person should check it shows real people or wildlife and carries no text. Contact phone is shown on the site as 0404 286 599 (and as +61 404 286 599 on the GCDA Travel page). The site's media library and a public YouTube feed for the linked channel were read for image sizes and video titles; no bot check or block was met.
